summary: scripts/ci-local sets PROPTEST_DISABLE_FAILURE_PERSISTENCE=1 for its stages, so a property test that fails on a try (and passes on nextest's retry) no longer writes proptest-regressions/ into the signing tree, which made the evidence signer refuse the whole run ('the checkout changed while the command ran').
